portal.name: No central portal. The UAE has four admissions environments and which one you are in decides everything about how and when you apply: federal institutions, UAE private universities, and branch campuses of foreign universities — and, on its own, NYU Abu Dhabi, which admits through NYU in New York on the American calendar.

institutions.name: New York University Abu Dhabi
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes. A full liberal arts and science curriculum across arts and humanities, engineering, science, social science and interdisciplinary majors, awarding an NYU degree.

institutions.name: Khalifa University of Science and Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, in engineering, computing, science, medicine and business, taught in English.

institutions.name: American University of Sharjah
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, on an American model: architecture and design, arts and sciences, business, engineering.

institutions.name: Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi
institutions.englishBachelors: Three bachelor's degrees taught in English: Physics, Mathematics (Data Science for Artificial Intelligence) and Records Management and Archival Science. Everything else is taught in French and needs a B2 French diploma.

institutions.name: Heriot-Watt University Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes: engineering, construction, business, computer science, psychology, design and fashion — awarding the Scottish Heriot-Watt degree.

institutions.name: University of Birmingham Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Business, economics, computer science, engineering, psychology and education, awarding the University of Birmingham degree.

institutions.name: University of Wollongong in Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Business, computer science, engineering, media and communication, and finance, awarding the Australian University of Wollongong degree.

institutions.name: Middlesex University Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: A broad range: business, law, psychology, computing, media, art and design, awarding the UK Middlesex University degree.

institutions.name: Rochester Institute of Technology Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Engineering, computing, business and information technology, awarding the American RIT degree.

institutions.name: American University in Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: American-accredited degrees in business, engineering, architecture, communication, visual communication and interior design.

institutions.name: United Arab Emirates University
institutions.englishBachelors: Most science, engineering, business and medicine programmes are taught in English; some humanities and law programmes are in Arabic.

institutions.name: Zayed University
institutions.englishBachelors: Business, communication and media, technological innovation, humanities and social sciences, taught in English.

institutions.name: Canadian University Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Business, engineering, architecture, communication, environmental health and applied sciences, on a Canadian curriculum model.

institutions.name: SP Jain School of Global Management, Dubai
institutions.englishBachelors: Bachelor of Business Administration and Bachelor of Data Science, taught across three or four campuses in Dubai, Mumbai, Singapore and Sydney.

portal.name: Each university's own application portal; study search via studienwahl.at

institutions.name: Vienna University of Economics and Business
institutions.englishBachelors: Business and Economics (BBE), taught entirely in English, 240 places in 2026/27.

institutions.name: Johannes Kepler University Linz
institutions.englishBachelors: Artificial Intelligence, taught in English with no German requirement (English B2); it can also be studied largely in Vienna.

institutions.name: University of Klagenfurt
institutions.englishBachelors: Six taught entirely in English: Digital Media, Culture and Communication; Information and Communications Engineering; International Business and Economics; Robotics and Artificial Intelligence; Social Sciences; Worlds of English.

institutions.name: MODUL University Vienna
institutions.englishBachelors: All teaching in English: International Management, Tourism and Hospitality Management, Applied Data Science, Human Resources Management and International Relations and Sustainability, among others.

institutions.name: Webster Vienna Private University
institutions.englishBachelors: Four English-taught American-style bachelor's: Business Administration, International Relations, Psychology and Strategic Communication.

institutions.name: IMC Krems University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: Nine taught in English, in business (including International Business Management, Tourism and Leisure Management, International Wine Business) and science (Chemistry, Informatics, Medical and Pharmaceutical Biotechnology); the health degrees are in German.

institutions.name: MCI - The Entrepreneurial School
institutions.englishBachelors: Business & Management and Entrepreneurship, Tourism & Leisure Business full-time in English, plus an online Business Administration; the engineering and life-science bachelor's are German-taught.

portal.name: UAC for New South Wales and the ACT, where an IB Diploma makes you eligible; direct to the university everywhere else

institutions.name: University of Melbourne
institutions.englishBachelors: Uses the 'Melbourne Model': broad three-year undergraduate degrees (Arts, Science, Commerce, Design, Biomedicine) followed by a professional master's for law, engineering, medicine or teaching.

institutions.name: University of Sydney
institutions.englishBachelors: Three-year bachelor's degrees with a shared open-learning component, plus combined degrees and direct-entry professional programmes.

institutions.name: Australian National University
institutions.englishBachelors: Three- and four-year degrees with a strong research-led first year and unusually small cohorts for a national university.

institutions.name: University of Queensland
institutions.englishBachelors: Broad three-year degrees plus dual programmes; strong life and environmental sciences.

institutions.name: Monash University
institutions.englishBachelors: Large faculty-based degrees with direct entry to professional programmes including medicine, pharmacy and engineering straight from school.

institutions.name: UNSW Sydney
institutions.englishBachelors: Runs a three-term calendar rather than two semesters, so there are more entry points and a faster path through the degree.

institutions.name: University of Western Australia
institutions.englishBachelors: Broad three-year bachelor's degrees followed by professional master's, similar in shape to Melbourne.

institutions.name: Adelaide University
institutions.englishBachelors: Bachelor's degrees across seven campuses in South Australia, including engineering, health and agricultural and wine science.

institutions.name: University of Technology Sydney
institutions.englishBachelors: Practice-oriented degrees with compulsory industry placements in several programmes.

institutions.name: RMIT University
institutions.englishBachelors: Design, engineering and technology degrees with strong studio and workshop teaching, plus a campus in Vietnam.

institutions.name: Queensland University of Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: Applied degrees branded 'the university for the real world', with work-integrated learning across most programmes.

institutions.name: University of Wollongong
institutions.englishBachelors: Mid-sized campus university 80 km south of Sydney, with strong engineering and computing.

institutions.name: Macquarie University
institutions.englishBachelors: Flexible degrees with a built-in professional placement unit, on a parkland campus next to a major business district.

institutions.name: Deakin University
institutions.englishBachelors: Multi-campus, with a large online and blended offering alongside on-campus degrees.

institutions.name: University of Tasmania
institutions.englishBachelors: Bachelor's degrees across arts, science, business, health and marine and Antarctic studies, with campuses in Hobart, Launceston and Burnie.

institutions.name: Griffith University
institutions.englishBachelors: More than 200 degrees open to international students, on campuses in Brisbane and on the Gold Coast.

institutions.name: Curtin University
institutions.englishBachelors: Bachelor's degrees in engineering, mining, health, business, design and the sciences at its main campus in Perth.

portal.name: None - you apply to each institution directly

institutions.name: KU Leuven
institutions.englishBachelors: A small number, including Business Administration, Business Engineering, European Studies, Philosophy and Theology and Religious Studies; most bachelor's are in Dutch

institutions.name: Ghent University
institutions.englishBachelors: Very limited: three English-taught bachelor's listed for 2026-2027; almost everything at bachelor level is in Dutch

institutions.name: University of Antwerp
institutions.englishBachelors: Two: Social-Economic Sciences and Urban Sustainability Studies; every other bachelor's is in Dutch

institutions.name: Vrije Universiteit Brussel
institutions.englishBachelors: Three: Business Economics, Linguistics and Literary Studies, and Social Sciences (taught with Ghent University)

institutions.name: Hasselt University
institutions.englishBachelors: None: every bachelor's programme is taught in Dutch; English starts at master's level

institutions.name: UCLouvain (Université catholique de Louvain)
institutions.englishBachelors: Essentially none - bachelor teaching is in French

institutions.name: Université libre de Bruxelles
institutions.englishBachelors: Essentially none at bachelor level; some English master's

institutions.name: University of Liège
institutions.englishBachelors: Essentially none at bachelor level

institutions.name: University of Mons
institutions.englishBachelors: Essentially none at bachelor level

institutions.name: Vesalius College
institutions.englishBachelors: Fully English-taught bachelor's in business, international affairs and communication

institutions.name: Karel de Grote University of Applied Sciences and Arts
institutions.englishBachelors: Several English-taught bachelor's, including business and multimedia routes

institutions.name: Thomas More University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: Several English-taught bachelor's in business and technology

institutions.name: Howest University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: Digital Arts and Entertainment is taught in English

institutions.name: University of Toronto
institutions.englishBachelors: Three campuses and hundreds of programmes; in Arts & Science you are admitted to a broad stream and choose your subject at the end of first year.

institutions.name: University of British Columbia
institutions.englishBachelors: Broad degrees in Arts, Science, Commerce, Engineering and more, across Vancouver and Okanagan campuses.

institutions.name: McGill University
institutions.englishBachelors: English-language teaching in a French-speaking city; admission is unusually transparent and almost purely grade-based.

institutions.name: University of Waterloo
institutions.englishBachelors: Best known for co-op degrees that alternate study terms with paid four-month work terms, typically six of them across the degree.

institutions.name: Queen's University at Kingston
institutions.englishBachelors: A compact residential campus in a small city, with a liberal-arts feel inside a research university.

institutions.name: McMaster University
institutions.englishBachelors: Known for problem-based learning, which it pioneered in medicine and now uses across health and science programmes.

institutions.name: Western University
institutions.englishBachelors: Large first-year cohorts in broad faculties, with entry into Ivey Business School and other professional schools after year two.

institutions.name: University of Alberta
institutions.englishBachelors: A large research university with strong sciences and a large engineering faculty.

institutions.name: University of Calgary
institutions.englishBachelors: Professional and applied programmes with strong co-op options, an hour from the Rocky Mountains.

institutions.name: Simon Fraser University
institutions.englishBachelors: Trimester system with three equal terms a year, so you can start in September, January or May and finish faster.

institutions.name: University of Victoria
institutions.englishBachelors: Mid-sized, heavily co-op, on Vancouver Island, with a mild climate.

institutions.name: Dalhousie University
institutions.englishBachelors: A research university in Halifax, a small maritime city with a large student population.

institutions.name: University of Ottawa
institutions.englishBachelors: Fully bilingual: you can take a degree in English, in French, or mix the two within the same programme.

institutions.name: Concordia University
institutions.englishBachelors: English-language, urban and applied, with strong creative and business programmes and a co-op option.

institutions.name: York University
institutions.englishBachelors: Honours bachelor's degrees in English across business, law and society, science, health and the arts, with bilingual degrees at its Glendon campus.

institutions.name: Toronto Metropolitan University
institutions.englishBachelors: Career-focused four-year degrees in business, engineering, media, communication and the arts and sciences, in downtown Toronto.

institutions.name: Carleton University
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year honours degrees across arts, science, engineering, business, journalism and public affairs.

institutions.name: University of Manitoba
institutions.englishBachelors: Bachelor's degrees taught in English across arts, science, engineering, agriculture, business and health.

institutions.name: University of Guelph
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year degrees with particular strength in agriculture, food, animal and environmental sciences, alongside arts, business and engineering.

institutions.name: University of Saskatchewan
institutions.englishBachelors: Bachelor's degrees taught in English across arts and science, agriculture, engineering, business and the health sciences.

portal.name: Each university applies directly; swissuniversities publishes the shared admission recommendations

institutions.name: ETH Zurich
institutions.englishBachelors: None - all bachelor's programmes are taught in German. English dominates at master's level.

institutions.name: EPFL - Ecole polytechnique federale de Lausanne
institutions.englishBachelors: None - the bachelor's is taught in French and requires French at B2.

institutions.name: University of St. Gallen
institutions.englishBachelors: The Assessment Year in economic sciences - leading to Business Administration, Economics, International Affairs or Law and Economics - can be taken entirely in English.

institutions.name: Universita della Svizzera italiana
institutions.englishBachelors: Informatics and Data Science are taught in English, and Economics has an English-language track alongside the Italian one. The other bachelor's are in Italian.

institutions.name: Franklin University Switzerland
institutions.englishBachelors: All bachelor's are taught in English, in a small American-style liberal arts structure.

institutions.name: EHL Hospitality Business School
institutions.englishBachelors: Bachelor in International Hospitality Management, taught in English.

institutions.name: Webster University Geneva
institutions.englishBachelors: English-taught American bachelor's degrees, mainly in business, international relations, media and psychology.

institutions.name: EU Business School - Geneva campus
institutions.englishBachelors: All teaching in English: a BBA and bachelor's in business finance, international relations, AI for business, sports management, digital business and tourism.

portal.name: No central portal, and no replacement for the one that has gone. Campus China (China Scholarship Council) was the official information and scholarship site and its domain no longer resolves; joint-venture universities use the Common Application or their own portals, and the Chinese universities publish inside login-gated application systems of their own.

institutions.name: Tsinghua University
institutions.englishBachelors: No fully English-taught bachelor's is listed. Tsinghua's applicant FAQ says undergraduate teaching is in Chinese, with some courses bilingual or in English, and asks for HSK 5 (or HSK 4 on entry and HSK 5 within a year).

institutions.name: Peking University
institutions.englishBachelors: Very limited. Yuanpei College is PKU's liberal-arts honours college but teaches principally in Chinese. The Yenching Academy is a one-year master's programme, not an undergraduate route. Most international undergraduates study in Mandarin.

institutions.name: Fudan University
institutions.englishBachelors: A small number of English-taught bachelor's programmes, historically including clinical medicine (MBBS) and some economics and international relations tracks. Verify directly.

institutions.name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
institutions.englishBachelors: Limited. Some English-taught tracks exist in engineering and medicine; the SJTU-ParisTech Elite Institute of Technology teaches in French and Chinese. Verify directly.

institutions.name: NYU Shanghai
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, taught entirely in English, across business, data science, computer science, humanities, social science, neuroscience and interactive media arts. Awards an NYU degree and a Chinese degree.

institutions.name: Duke Kunshan University
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, taught in English, across a liberal arts and sciences curriculum with interdisciplinary majors. Graduates receive both a US degree and a Chinese degree.

institutions.name: Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University
institutions.englishBachelors: Over 60 undergraduate programmes, all taught in English, across engineering, science, business, humanities, film and design. Graduates receive dual XJTLU and University of Liverpool degrees.

institutions.name: University of Nottingham Ningbo China
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, taught in English, awarding a University of Nottingham degree. Business, engineering, international studies, education and science.

institutions.name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, taught in English, across science and engineering, management and economics, humanities and social science, data science, medicine and music. Awards a CUHK degree.

institutions.name: Beijing Normal-Hong Kong Baptist University
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, taught entirely in English, in a whole-person liberal arts model: business, culture and creativity, humanities and social science, science and technology.

institutions.name: Wenzhou-Kean University
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, taught in English by an American faculty, awarding both a Kean University (New Jersey) degree and a Chinese degree. Business, computer science, architecture, psychology, biology and education.

institutions.name: Zhejiang University
institutions.englishBachelors: Limited at the main university; the ZJU-UoE Institute (with Edinburgh) and ZJU-UIUC Institute (with Illinois) at the Haining International Campus teach in English and award dual degrees.

institutions.name: Tongji University
institutions.englishBachelors: A small number of English-taught bachelor's programmes, historically in civil engineering and architecture. Verify directly.

institutions.name: Sun Yat-sen University
institutions.englishBachelors: Limited. Some English-taught medicine and business tracks; most undergraduate teaching is in Mandarin. Verify directly.

portal.name: None. The official national portal states there is no single central application form — each institution, and usually each faculty, runs its own. studyin.gov.cz has a searchable programme database.

institutions.name: Charles University
institutions.englishBachelors: Not published as a bachelor's-only count. The university reports over 850 accredited programmes with more than 200 in languages other than Czech, across all levels.

institutions.name: Masaryk University
institutions.englishBachelors: Around 11 — including Biology and Biochemistry, Data Analytics, English Language and Literature, Business Management and Finance, International Relations and European Politics, and Global Challenges. Plus General Medicine and Dentistry.

institutions.name: Czech Technical University in Prague
institutions.englishBachelors: Not published as a count — the official list is a PDF. English-taught bachelor's degrees exist at the Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Nuclear Sciences, Architecture, Transportation, Biomedical and Information Technology faculties.

institutions.name: Prague University of Economics and Business
institutions.englishBachelors: 8 — Economics, Business Administration, International Business, International and Diplomatic Studies, Economics of Markets and Organizations, Economic Data Science, plus Finance and Accounting and Business Information Systems, both opening in September 2027

institutions.name: Palacký University Olomouc
institutions.englishBachelors: Not published as a count — it describes a wide range of English-taught programmes across eight faculties without giving a number.

institutions.name: Czech University of Life Sciences Prague
institutions.englishBachelors: 10 — Business Administration, Economics and Management, Informatics, Agriculture and Food, Sustainable Use of Natural Resources, Agricultural Engineering, Environmental Data Science, Environmental Engineering, Forestry, and International Cooperation in Agriculture and Rural Development

institutions.name: Brno University of Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: Effectively 1 — Electrical Engineering, three years, with specialisations in electronics and communication technologies or in power systems and automation

institutions.name: University of Chemistry and Technology, Prague
institutions.englishBachelors: 8 — Catalysis and Manufacturing of (In)organic Compounds, Inorganic Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Materials, Physical and Computational Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, plus a business economics and management school

institutions.name: Anglo-American University
institutions.englishBachelors: Not published as a count. Programmes span business administration, international relations, humanities and journalism.

institutions.name: VSB - Technical University of Ostrava
institutions.englishBachelors: Not published as a count. English-taught bachelor's degrees exist across seven faculties, with admission conditions varying by faculty.

institutions.name: University of West Bohemia
institutions.englishBachelors: 1 — Management and Digital Technology at the Faculty of Economics, run as a four-year double degree

institutions.name: Academy of Performing Arts in Prague
institutions.englishBachelors: 3 — Authorial Acting at the theatre faculty, Photography at FAMU, and Dance Pedagogy at the music and dance faculty

institutions.name: University of South Bohemia in České Budějovice
institutions.englishBachelors: 1 — Biological Chemistry at the Faculty of Science, three years. The rest of its English catalogue is master's and doctoral.

portal.name: hochschulstart.de (medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine, pharmacy) and uni-assist or the university's own portal for everything else

institutions.name: Technical University of Munich
institutions.englishBachelors: A handful: Aerospace (Garching/Ottobrunn, which still asks for German at A2), and Management & Data Science and Information Engineering at TUM Campus Heilbronn.

institutions.name: University of Freiburg - University College Freiburg
institutions.englishBachelors: Liberal Arts and Sciences BA/BSc, taught in English - described as the first English-language liberal arts degree at a German public university.

institutions.name: Rhine-Waal University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: A large share of its bachelor's degrees are taught entirely in English, across engineering, life sciences, society and economics.

institutions.name: Constructor University
institutions.englishBachelors: All bachelor's taught in English, on a residential international campus.

institutions.name: Free University of Berlin
institutions.englishBachelors: One: the single-subject BA in North American Studies, taught in English with no German requirement.

institutions.name: Bard College Berlin
institutions.englishBachelors: English-taught liberal arts bachelor's, awarded as both a German BA and a US BA.

institutions.name: Frankfurt School of Finance & Management
institutions.englishBachelors: Artificial Intelligence & Data Engineering; Management, Philosophy & Economics; and Business Information Systems Engineering are taught in English, and Business Administration in English and German.

institutions.name: WHU - Otto Beisheim School of Management
institutions.englishBachelors: Bachelor in International Business Administration, taught in English.

institutions.name: Leuphana University Luneburg
institutions.englishBachelors: Seven majors taught entirely in English, among them Economics, Psychology, Digital Media, Global Environmental and Sustainability Sciences, and International Business Administration & Entrepreneurship.

portal.name: DreamApply Estonia — one interface shared by nine institutions, but each sets its own deadlines and decisions

institutions.name: University of Tartu
institutions.englishBachelors: 3 — Business Administration (4,200 euros a year), Science and Technology (6,000), and a six-year integrated Medicine (13,200)

institutions.name: Tallinn University of Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: 4 — Cyber Security Engineering and Integrated Engineering, both free for EU/EEA citizens, plus International Business Administration and Law at 5,000 euros a year

institutions.name: Tallinn University
institutions.englishBachelors: 6 — Liberal Arts in Humanities (4,200 euros), Crossmedia (4,600), Liberal Arts in Social Sciences (4,600), Audiovisual Media (4,800), Politics and Governance (4,800), Law (5,400)

institutions.name: Estonian Business School
institutions.englishBachelors: 3 — Impactful Entrepreneurship (7,730 euros a year), International Business Administration (7,730), Product and Technology Management (8,100)

institutions.name: Estonian University of Life Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: 1 — Veterinary Medicine, 9,800 euros a year

institutions.name: Estonian Academy of Music and Theatre
institutions.englishBachelors: 2 — Classical Music Performance and Composition and Improvisational Music, both 1,750 euros a year for EU students and 7,700 for non-EU

institutions.name: Estonian Aviation Academy
institutions.englishBachelors: 2 listed — Commercial Air Transport Pilot (8,100 euros a year) and Commercial Aviation Management (3,780), but the management programme had no intake in 2026/27

institutions.name: Tallinn Health University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: 1 — Assistant Pharmacist, 6,200 euros a year

institutions.name: Estonian Entrepreneurship University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: 4 — Creativity and Business Innovation (also as a joint programme), Artificial Intelligence Driven Software Technologies and Entrepreneurship, Game Design and Development. The national list gave 7,120 euros a year for EU students and 7,520 for non-EU.

institutions.name: Baltic Methodist Theological Seminary
institutions.englishBachelors: 1 — Theology and Mission, 2,600 euros a year

portal.name: UNEDasiss (accreditation) then each region's preinscripción system

institutions.name: IE University
institutions.englishBachelors: Almost the entire bachelor portfolio is taught in English

institutions.name: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
institutions.englishBachelors: A substantial English-taught offer including Economics, International Studies, Aerospace Engineering and Data Science

institutions.name: Universitat Pompeu Fabra
institutions.englishBachelors: International Business Economics is taught entirely in English; Global Studies is taught in English for its first two years

institutions.name: Universidad de Navarra
institutions.englishBachelors: No fully English-taught bachelor's: English-taught 'international programme' tracks inside Spanish degrees (Medicine, the sciences, some engineering) and bilingual business and economics degrees

institutions.name: ESADE
institutions.city: Barcelona and Sant Cugat del Vallès
institutions.englishBachelors: Global Governance, Economics & Legal Order, Business and Artificial Intelligence, and Transformational Leadership and Social Impact are taught entirely in English; the BBA has an English section; Law is Spanish with English phased in

institutions.name: Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona
institutions.englishBachelors: A small number of English-taught bachelors

institutions.name: Universidad de Deusto
institutions.englishBachelors: Business Management and Administration can be studied 100% in English; several engineering and data science degrees are bilingual Spanish–English

institutions.name: Universidad Pontificia Comillas (ICADE)
institutions.englishBachelors: English-taught and bilingual bachelors in business, law and international relations

institutions.name: Universidad CEU San Pablo
institutions.englishBachelors: Dentistry and Physiotherapy are taught in English; Business Administration and several others are bilingual

institutions.name: Universidad Autónoma de Madrid
institutions.englishBachelors: A limited English-taught offer

institutions.name: Universitat de Barcelona
institutions.englishBachelors: A small English-taught offer at bachelor level

institutions.name: Universidad Complutense de Madrid
institutions.englishBachelors: Very limited at bachelor level; some bilingual groups

institutions.name: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya
institutions.englishBachelors: A small English-taught engineering offer

portal.name: Studyinfo (Opintopolku)

institutions.name: University of Helsinki
institutions.englishBachelors: 2 — Liberal Arts and Sciences, and Science

institutions.name: Aalto University
institutions.englishBachelors: 6 programmes presented as 11 application options, including Design and Media, Economics, Finance, International Business, Computer Engineering, Data Science and Quantum Technology. Aalto's own page contradicts itself on the count.

institutions.name: Tampere University
institutions.englishBachelors: 11 — including Automation and Robotics, Biomedical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, Environmental Engineering and three Sustainable Urban Development tracks

institutions.name: LUT University
institutions.englishBachelors: 15 — every bachelor's degree LUT offers is taught in English, 13 in technology and 2 in business. Four of the technology options are double degrees with Hebei University of Technology (HEBUT) in China.

institutions.name: University of Oulu
institutions.englishBachelors: 4 — Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communications Engineering, Software Engineering and Information Systems, International Business Management, all 3+2

institutions.name: University of Turku
institutions.englishBachelors: 2 — Sustainable and Social Entrepreneurship, and Information and Communication Technology (a combined 3+2). The count is uncertain because of how the ICT degree is listed.

institutions.name: University of Jyväskylä
institutions.englishBachelors: 3 — Business Innovation and Sustainability, Immersive Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence, Early Childhood Education

institutions.name: Åbo Akademi University
institutions.englishBachelors: None. Every bachelor's degree at Åbo Akademi is taught in Swedish and requires documented Swedish. Nine international master's degrees are taught in English.

institutions.name: University of Eastern Finland
institutions.englishBachelors: At least one: Human and Planetary Health (Kuopio, 3 years), which is on the national certificate-based admission list. The full list is not confirmed here; check UEF's own pages.

institutions.name: Metropolia University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: 32 listed for the January 2027 cycle, but that count includes top-up degrees that require a prior qualification and duplicate delivery modes. The number genuinely open to a school leaver is lower.

institutions.name: Haaga-Helia University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: 8 — Aviation Business, Business Information Technology, Digital Business Innovations, International Business, three hospitality and tourism degrees, and Sports Coaching and Management. All 210 ECTS over about 3.5 years.

institutions.name: Tampere University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: 10 — including Environmental Engineering and Green Transition, Software Engineering, Textile and Material Engineering, Media and Arts, International Business and Team Entrepreneurship

institutions.name: Laurea University of Applied Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: 7 — Nursing, Social Services, Service Experience Management, Safety Security and Risk Management, Business Management, Cyber Security, Developing Digital Services. All 210 ECTS over 3.5 years.

institutions.name: University of Tokyo
institutions.englishBachelors: The UTokyo College of Design, opening September 2027: a five-year integrated bachelor's and master's programme taught in English, 100 places, half of them on Route B for international qualifications including the IB (expected level 38/42 plus 2 core points, not a cut-off). PEAK closed after its September 2026 intake. The Global Science Course is a third-year transfer route, not an entry point from school.

institutions.name: Kyoto University
institutions.englishBachelors: iUP — a 4.5-year route: six months of intensive preparatory Japanese, then four years of undergraduate study across a range of faculties. No Japanese required at the start.

institutions.name: Waseda University
institutions.englishBachelors: Six schools: Political Science and Economics, Social Sciences, International Liberal Studies (SILS), Culture Media and Society, Fundamental Science and Engineering, Creative Science and Engineering. SILS and Culture Media and Society also take April entrants.

institutions.name: Keio University
institutions.englishBachelors: PEARL (Programme in Economics for Alliances, Research and Leadership) in the Faculty of Economics — about 100 places, entry 22 September 2027, three application periods closing 2 December 2026, 27 January 2027 and 7 April 2027, accepting an IB Diploma or predicted grades with TOEFL iBT or IELTS. GIGA (Global Information and Governance Academic) in Environment and Information Studies at Shonan Fujisawa is not covered in detail here.

institutions.name: Sophia University
institutions.englishBachelors: Faculty of Liberal Arts (BA in Liberal Arts); the Sophia Program for Sustainable Futures (BAs in Journalism, Education, Sociology, Economics, Management, International Relations and Area Studies); and a Bachelor of Engineering in Digital Green Technology. The Green Science and Green Engineering courses admitted their last students in autumn 2026.

institutions.name: Tohoku University
institutions.englishBachelors: Gateway College, new in 2027: an English-taught undergraduate programme with a Humanities and Social Sciences track and a STEM track, taking about 90 students in October and 88 in April. It replaces the Future Global Leadership (FGL) courses, which admitted their last students in 2026.

institutions.name: International Christian University
institutions.englishBachelors: A single bilingual Bachelor of Arts in Liberal Arts with 31 majors; you declare your major at the end of second year. Entry is possible in April or September.

institutions.englishBachelors: International undergraduate programmes taught in English, October entry: engineering (several departments) and Bioresource and Bioenvironment in the School of Agriculture. Applications for October 2027 run 7–11 December 2026.

institutions.name: The University of Osaka

portal.name: None. Universities New Zealand states that applications should be made direct to the universities.

institutions.name: University of Auckland
institutions.englishBachelors: A broad offering, including conjoint (double) degrees that combine two bachelor's in about four to five years.

institutions.name: University of Otago
institutions.englishBachelors: New Zealand's oldest university, with a famously residential first year and a large health sciences pathway.

institutions.name: Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka
institutions.englishBachelors: Three-year bachelor's degrees in the capital, with strong law, public policy and creative writing.

institutions.name: University of Canterbury
institutions.englishBachelors: Traditional campus university with a large engineering school and a well-known forestry programme.

institutions.name: Massey University
institutions.englishBachelors: Three campuses plus a large distance-learning operation; unusually strong in agriculture, veterinary science and aviation.

institutions.name: University of Waikato
institutions.englishBachelors: Mid-sized, with a management school and a well-regarded computing and mathematical sciences faculty.

institutions.name: Auckland University of Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: Practice-focused degrees with compulsory work placements in many programmes; New Zealand's youngest university.

institutions.name: Lincoln University
institutions.englishBachelors: New Zealand's smallest university, specialising entirely in land, food and environment.

institutions.name: Unitec
institutions.englishBachelors: Applied bachelor's degrees in construction, computing, design and social practice, with lower entry requirements than the universities.

institutions.name: Otago Polytechnic
institutions.englishBachelors: Hands-on bachelor's degrees in design, engineering technology, nursing and occupational therapy.

portal.name: None nationally. Almost every university runs its own IRK system (Internetowa Rekrutacja Kandydatow) - irk.uw.edu.pl at Warsaw, irk.uj.edu.pl at the Jagiellonian, irk.usos.pwr.edu.pl at Wroclaw Tech, e-Rekrutacja at AGH, applicant.ump.edu.pl at Poznan Medical.

institutions.name: University of Warsaw
institutions.englishBachelors: At least 11 English-taught bachelor and long-cycle programmes in the official 2026/27 fee schedule: American Studies, Archaeology, Business and Management, English Studies, European Politics and Economics, Finance International Investment and Accounting, International Relations, International Studies in Philosophy, Political Science, Psychology (long-cycle) and Social and Public Policy

institutions.name: Jagiellonian University
institutions.englishBachelors: 7 English-taught first-cycle programmes - Earth Sciences in a Changing World, East European Studies, European Studies, Global and Development Studies, International Relations and Area Studies, Mathematics and Computer Science Advanced Track, Responsible Entrepreneurship and Management - plus the Una Europa Joint Bachelor in Sustainability and the School of Medicine in English

institutions.name: Warsaw University of Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: 11 English-taught BSc programmes for 2026/27, among them Architecture, Civil Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics and two in computer science. Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering and Power Engineering are free for EU citizens

institutions.name: AGH University of Krakow
institutions.englishBachelors: 7 English-taught bachelor's: Computer Physics, Computer Science, Computer Science for Embedded Systems, Geology of Natural Resources, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronic Engineering and Space Engineering

institutions.name: SGH Warsaw School of Economics
institutions.englishBachelors: Four in English: Global Business, Finance and Governance; International Economics; Management; Quantitative Methods in Economics and Information Systems. Fees not confirmed here

institutions.name: Wroclaw University of Science and Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: 33 programmes fully taught in English across bachelor's and master's, out of 62 bachelor's and 57 master's programmes in total. Verified English-taught bachelor's with 2026/27 prices: Applied Computer Science, Management, Mechanical Engineering, Medical Informatics and Electronic and Computer Engineering

institutions.name: Poznan University of Medical Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: English-taught six-year MD and Dentistry, plus a Medical Summer Program

institutions.name: Medical University of Gdansk
institutions.englishBachelors: Four English-taught programmes plus a preparatory year: the six-year Doctor of Medicine, five-year Master of Pharmacy, three-year Bachelor of Nursing, a two-year International Master in Sustainable Drug Discovery, and a one-year Premedical Course

institutions.name: Medical University of Warsaw
institutions.englishBachelors: Two in English: six-year Medicine (MD) and five-year Dentistry (DDS). Fees and deadlines are on separate recruitment sites; check them there

institutions.name: Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznan
institutions.englishBachelors: Nine English-taught bachelor's, including International Relations, Chemistry, European Legal Studies, Liberal Arts and Sciences and Global Communication. Fees not confirmed here

institutions.name: University of Wroclaw
institutions.englishBachelors: 12 English-taught bachelor's, including Biotechnology, Business and Administration, Criminal Justice, International Relations, Political Science and an LLB in International and European Environmental Law. Fees not confirmed here

institutions.name: Poznan University of Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: Ten English-taught BSc programmes, including Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Automatic Control and Robotics, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Quantum Technologies. Fees not confirmed here

institutions.name: SWPS University
institutions.englishBachelors: Six in Warsaw: Psychology, Computer Science, Design (School of Form), English Studies, English Studies with Additional Language, and Management and Leadership

portal.name: No shared application — six autonomous universities, six forms, six fees, six deadlines. There is a shared acceptance: every offer you hold across them is settled once, in the Joint Acceptance Portal.

institutions.name: National University of Singapore
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes, across a comprehensive range of faculties.

institutions.name: Nanyang Technological University
institutions.englishBachelors: All programmes: engineering, science, business (Nanyang Business School), humanities, medicine (Lee Kong Chian) and education.

institutions.name: Singapore Management University

institutions.name: Singapore Institute of Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: Applied degrees in engineering, health and social sciences, infocomm technology, food technology and hospitality — many with an integrated work-study year.

institutions.name: Singapore University of Social Sciences
institutions.englishBachelors: Social sciences, business, law, human development and early childhood education, with both full-time and part-time routes.

institutions.name: Nanyang Academy of Fine Arts

institutions.name: Curtin Singapore

institutions.name: Singapore Institute of Management (SIM Global Education)

institutions.name: ESSEC Business School Asia-Pacific

institutions.name: International School for Social and Business Studies
institutions.englishBachelors: Not established: its two bachelor's (Economics in Contemporary Society; Business in Contemporary Society) are described in English but no teaching language is stated, and neither is on the national list of English-taught programmes.

portal.name: Three application environments, not one: the Common App, the University of California application, and institutions that take only their own

institutions.name: Harvard University
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year AB or SB; you declare a concentration in the second year.

institutions.name: Yale University
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year BA or BS across roughly 80 majors, with a strong residential college system.

institutions.name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year SB degrees; everyone takes the same science and maths core in year one.

institutions.name: Stanford University
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year BA/BS on a quarter system, so you take more, shorter courses than at most US universities.

institutions.name: Amherst College
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year BA with an open curriculum - no distribution requirements at all beyond your major.

institutions.name: Bowdoin College
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year BA, about 1,800 students, small classes and no graduate students competing for attention.

institutions.name: Grinnell College
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year BA with an individually advised curriculum; roughly 1,700 students and an unusually high international share.

institutions.name: Macalester College
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year BA with an explicit internationalist mission; around 2,000 students in a real city.

institutions.name: Colby College
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year BA, about 2,400 students and 48 majors, with a January term for one intensive project.

institutions.name: New York University
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year degrees across separate schools - you apply to one school, such as Stern or Tisch, not to NYU in general.

institutions.name: University of Michigan-Ann Arbor
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year degrees - more than 280 programmes in 15 undergraduate schools and colleges, with a large liberal arts college at the centre.

institutions.name: University of California, Berkeley
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year BA/BS; you apply to a college within Berkeley, and some majors are capped.

institutions.name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year degrees; you apply to a specific major, and engineering and computer science are far harder to enter than the university overall.

institutions.name: Arizona State University
institutions.englishBachelors: Four-year degrees across more than 350 undergraduate programmes, with published admission criteria rather than holistic review.
